hotlines.name: National Emergency Hotline
hotlines.notes: Nationwide single emergency number (police, fire, medical, disaster); operates 24/7. Sorsogon province also routes its citizenry emergency calls through 911.

hotlines.name: NDRRMC Operations Center
hotlines.notes: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council operations center in Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City. Verifier: NDRRMC has at times published temporary operations-center hotlines via its Facebook page; confirm these landlines are current before publishing.

hotlines.name: Philippine Red Cross (National Hotline)
hotlines.notes: National emergency hotline 143 and trunkline for the Philippine Red Cross; call to be routed to the Sorsogon/Bicol chapter.

hotlines.name: Sorsogon Provincial DRRM Office (SPDRRMO)
hotlines.notes: SPDRRMO Building, Arnedo Street, Capitol Compound, Sorsogon City. Email: spdrrm@sorsogon.gov.ph. Provincial calls for citizens are also routed via the 911 emergency hotline.

hotlines.name: Sorsogon Police Provincial Office (PPO)
hotlines.notes: Camp Salvador C. Escudero Sr., Brgy. Sampaloc, Sorsogon City. 0998-598-6062 is the PNP number published on the provincial government emergency-hotlines page; 09985986059 / 09399169319 are from the official SPPO website.

hotlines.name: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Sorsogon
